description: This class includes the manufacture of power-driven hand tools.
includes: manufacture of hand tools with self-contained electric motor: drills, chainsaws, circular saws, jigsaws, planers, routers, sanders
manufacture of hand tools with self-contained pneumatic motor: nail guns, spray guns, impact wrenches
manufacture of hand tools with self-contained combustion engine: chainsaws, lawn mowers
excludes: manufacture of hand tools without power, see 2593
manufacture of professional electrical equipment, see 2790
